title: H3 Reference runs on Singularity v2 (name unchanged) + sol-attn speed on both H3 models, licence check first
description: Fabio, 2026-10-25 (MPI-1135 Phase 1e): Singularity is NOT an image-to-video model: any LoRA, and any prompt that describes the picture, loses the first frame. So MiniMax H3 (fl2va) STAYS and only gains the approved speed method (sol-attn always on; non-turbo sol-attn + EasyCache). MiniMax H3 Reference keeps its name but its base model becomes Singularity H3 v2 (Minimax-h3_Singularity_ref2va_v2_pruned_int8.safetensors, 20.97 GB) with the same speed method. Before wiring: (1) licence check: the repo says apache-2.0, but it is an H3 fine-tune, so treat it as bound by the H3 Community Licence and its territory clause. (2) docs/playbooks/add-model/README.md 'Removing or re-tiering': never delete the old ref2va dep entry. Brief: brief.md.
